Common Queries:

Confidence-Based Query Examples:

1. Find ProductType nodes with high MAY_VIOLATE confidence (>= 0.4) to Subcategory nodes
   Cypher: MATCH (s:ProductType)-[r:MAY_VIOLATE]->(t:Subcategory) WHERE r.confidence_score >= 0.4 RETURN s.name AS Source, t.name AS Target, r.confidence_score AS Confidence ORDER BY r.confidence_score DESC LIMIT 10

2. Find hierarchical paths through ProductType nodes with high MAY_VIOLATE confidence
   Cypher: MATCH path = (parent)-[:PARENT_OF*]->(child)-[r:MAY_VIOLATE]->(t:Subcategory) WHERE r.confidence_score >= 0.4 RETURN [node IN nodes(path) | coalesce(node.name, labels(node)[0])] AS Hierarchy, t.name AS Target, r.confidence_score AS Confidence LIMIT 10
